text:
olivia: running into a typing regression when our JS SDK is consumed by ESM edge runtimes. generics + overloads lose inference after publish.
ken: paste a tiny repro plz. sounds like dts bundling again but could be package layout.
olivia: stripped repro:
```ts
// lib/client.ts
export function get<T = { id: string }>(id: string): Promise<T>;
export function get(id: string) { return Promise.resolve({ id }); }
```
consumer (ESM, TS 5.1):
```ts
import { get } from 'redwood-sdk';
const x = await get('a');
// x is any in downstream project after npm install
```
mina: locally `tsc` shows Promise<{id:string}>, but installed package only exposes `index.d.ts` created by tsup dts plugin with a collapsed signature.
ci-bot: CI note: `packages/sdk` build job: "dts: collapsed overloads into single signature" warning.
pat: we've seen this pattern: tsup's dts bundling discards overload generics/defaults. fix paths:
- Use `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly` to generate per-file d.ts into dist/types.
- Keep tsup for JS only (cjs+esm).
- Ensure package.json `types` points to dist/types/index.d.ts and leave top-level `types` field for older consumers.
ken: also double-check `exports` mapping. Some bundlers ignore `exports.types` so `types` field is still helpful. recommended package.json snippet: {"types":"dist/types/index.d.ts","exports":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}}.
olivia: alternative quick patch: add handwritten `types/index.d.ts` that re-declares overloads. but that's manual and error-prone.
mina: CI smoke test: add an `examples/edge-typing-check` folder that installs the built package via `pnpm link` or `pnpm pack` and runs `tsc --noEmit` in an ESM project. Add matrix entry for Node 20 + TS 5.x and `moduleResolution: 'bundler'`.
ci-bot: created issue #4280: "Publish unbundled d.ts for SDK to preserve overload generics" assigned to ken.
ken: I'll open a PR to change build to `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json --outDir dist/types` then run tsup for JS. will also add `npm pack` based test in CI.
pat: thanks. if we do this, also add a short doc note in SDK migration guide about ESM edge consumers and tsconfigGotchas (moduleResolution, target, libs).
olivia: will verify on a Vercel edge preview once PR merges. reporting back after that. :raised_hands:
